name: Question 5
problem: Change the order of integration in the double integral ${\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{2y-2}^{2}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.$
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14071085/assets/062d32beb0cab13297c21b2eab703fd5e598191c96daa93a9c27337af95a1930.png)

The diagram above shows the region of integration. It is a type II region, and its type II representation is

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,1\le y\le 2,\,2y-2\le x\le 2}.
$$

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form $x=x(y),$ is

$$
x=2y-2\,⟹\,y=\frac{x+2}{2},
$$

and the bottom boundary of the region is

$$
y=1.
$$

To change the order of integration, we write $D$ as a type I region. The type I representation of the region is

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 2,\,1\le y\le \frac{x+2}{2}},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14071085/assets/543ffc57d0d32ae9a4bdefa87bd56deb7380061004b7737cf821117b4fb20e2f.png)

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{2y-2}^{2}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{1}^{(x+2)/2}f(x,y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 5
?

Change the order of integration in the double integral ∫12∫2y−22f(x,y)dxdy.

a
∫(x+2)/22∫01f(x,y)dydx
b
∫02∫1(x+2)/2f(x,y)dydx
c
∫01∫2(x+2)/2f(x,y)dydx
d
∫02∫(x+2)/21f(x,y)dydx
e
∫0(x+2)/2∫12f(x,y)dydx
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The diagram above shows the region of integration. It is a type II region, and its type II representation is

D={(x,y):1≤y≤2,2y−2≤x≤2}.

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form x=x(y), is

x=2y−2⟹y=x+22,

and the bottom boundary of the region is

y=1.

To change the order of integration, we write D as a type I region. The type I representation of the region is

D={(x,y):0≤x≤2,1≤y≤x+22},

as shown in the diagram below.

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain

∫12∫2y−22f(x,y)dxdy=∫02∫1(x+2)/2f(x,y)dydx.
